system:
Decide one routing question: are the still images actual first/last frames, or content references redrawn into a new scene? Interpret the complete user request semantically, not a keyword list. An actual opening frame selects i2va, an actual closing frame l2va, two opening/closing frames fl2va. Identity, environment, style, storyboard or a character appearing in a new scene selects ref2va.
Return interpretation anchor_instruction for a clear instruction to make an input the actual frame; content_reference_instruction for a clear content-reference request; two_subjects only for two pictures depicting distinct things which must appear together; ambiguous if neither meaning is specified. Ambiguous selects ref2va while recording that soft reference conditioning cannot guarantee an exact frame. Return anchor_instruction_present true only when the user actually requests anchoring, with source_quote quoting that instruction exactly. Otherwise source_quote may be empty.
When the schema pins declared_reference and mode, do NOT reroute: the caller's declared responsibilities govern. Only audit whether the prose conflicts by asking for an actual frame. Report anchor_instruction_present and its exact quote; never report a conflict just because an image is attached. A reference role with normal appearance-in-scene wording has no override. Caller roles/provenance outrank ambiguous prose. confidence is your own interpretation confidence; the host records it separately from the deterministic compatibility routing policy. Never invent observations about unread media. Return JSON only.

brief.intent: the woman in the technical jacket rides the dragon into an epic battleground, cinematic hollywood scene with dramatic expressions and camera movements

cards.summary: A vertical character reference sheet for a dark-clad male action character. It combines a cinematic rainy-night hero shot on a bridge with studio front, side-profile, and back turnarounds, plus close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.

subjects.descriptor: Adult man with a lean build and close-shaved undercut, shown as the same identity across all panels.
attributes: shaved sides with dark hair gathered into a small back topknot
diagonal scar above his right eyebrow on the viewer-left side of his face
black high-collar field or tactical jacket with shoulder straps and buckles
pose: In the HERO panel, stands upright and slightly angled, with his head turned toward viewer-right and a neutral expression.
In the studio FRONT view, faces the camera directly.
In the SIDE PROFILE view, faces viewer-left in profile.
In the BACK view, faces away from the camera.
In the FACE close-up, faces the camera with a stern, neutral expression.

cards.environment: The hero panel is a wet urban bridge or walkway at night with metal railings and blurred city lights; the remaining panels use a dark neutral studio backdrop.
cards.lighting: Cinematic low-key lighting: cool blue-gray rain scene with warm amber background practicals; the studio panels use soft, dark, directional light.
cards.framing: Vertical composite layout: a wide full-body cinematic shot at the top, three full-body studio turnaround views in a row, and four close-up detail crops in a row below.
cards.style: Dark cinematic action-character concept art and photographic reference sheet, realistic.

cards.summary: A dark fantasy creature reference sheet for a single black dragon, featuring a wide volcanic hero image plus front, side, rear, head, wing, claw, and scale-detail panels.

subjects.descriptor: single black dragon design shown across the reference sheet
attributes: very dark charcoal-to-black scales with subtle blue-green iridescence
long pale bone-colored horns sweeping backward
spiked crest along the head and spine
pose: hero panel: crouched or standing low with head lowered left and wings partly spread
front view: symmetric stance facing the viewer with wings spread
side profile: standing with head and neck extended
rear view: standing with wings spread
close-up panels: static head, wing, foot, and scale details

cards.environment: Hero panel: volcanic rocky terrain with dark water or wet ground, jagged mountains, glowing embers, and lava light. Detail panels: plain dark grey studio-like backgrounds.
cards.lighting: Low-key dramatic lighting; warm orange rim light and lava glow in the hero scene, softer neutral light in the reference and detail panels.
cards.framing: Composite reference sheet: one wide hero panel at the top; three full-body turnaround panels in the middle row; four close-up detail panels in the bottom row, separated by thin black borders.
cards.style: Dark fantasy creature concept art with photorealistic high-detail rendering and turnaround/reference-sheet presentation.
cards.characterisation: A massive, armored-looking black dragon with swept-back horns, spiked crest, membranous wings, clawed limbs, and a long spiked tail, presented as a consistent design across multiple views.
